THE DRIFTING LANTERN ISLE: a small island drifting slowly above a misty green valley, a whitewashed cottage and a crooked apple tree on its flat top, three waterfalls trailing off its mossy underside, thick gnarled roots hanging below, and a rope ladder dangling from the rim toward the meadow far beneath

THE BELLSPIRE OF CROOKEDHILL: a slender stone spire leaning at a cheerful angle atop a round green hill, a great iron bell visible in its open arch near the crown, a weathervane shaped like a running fox spinning at its very tip, and a zigzag stair of pale stone climbing the hillside to its arched doorway

THE GLASS-CROWN TOWER: a tall slender tower rising above the cloudline, its shaft of pale fitted stone narrowing gracefully upward, a round room of clear glass panels gleaming at its crown, a single lit window partway up, and a rope bridge swaying from a ledge to a neighbouring cloud-wrapped pinnacle of rock

THE GIANT CANOPY VILLAGE: an enormous tree whose trunk is as wide as a town square and whose boughs spread like a second horizon, rope bridges linking platform to platform high in its branches, lanterns hung by the hundred along every bough, and a little watermill turning on a stream that runs between two of its surface roots

THE ROOTWOOD BOROUGH: a colossal tree standing in a wide amber meadow, a cluster of stout timber-and-plaster cottages nestled in the fork of its three main boughs, rope bridges strung between the branches, glowing paper lanterns hanging from the smallest twigs, and a spiral wooden stair carved directly into the bark of the trunk

THE BOUGH-VILLAGE TREE: an ancient tree of impossible girth rising from a mossy river island, its upper branches divided into a broad tangle that supports a full village of peaked rooftops and plain coloured banners, rope bridges running in every direction between the boughs, and a rowboat tied to one of the great arching surface roots below

THE CRYSTAL GROTTO OF THE STILL LAKE: a wide cavern mouth framed by giant glowing amethyst crystals, their chunky stepped pixel sides glowing soft violet across a perfectly still underground lake, a narrow stone bridge arching over the water toward a second chamber glowing deeper inside, and a cluster of smaller crystal formations growing from the cavern floor like a garden

THE VALLEY OF SPIRES: a hidden valley where hundreds of translucent crystal spires of rose and gold grow from the earth like a frozen forest, the tallest reaching far above the treetops, a worn stone path winding between their bases, and a single small stone arch at the valley's entrance carved with a pictorial relief of a sun with a face

THE GLOWING GEODE HOLLOW: a great round grotto whose entire domed ceiling is lined with enormous pale-blue crystals glowing with soft steady light, a dark mirror lake filling the hollow floor and reflecting every crystal above, a wooden jetty extending over the water, and a small rowboat tied to the jetty post with a yellow rope

CASTLE MIRRORLAKE: a castle of pale stone standing on a low island in a wide calm lake, its many slender turrets each topped with a pennant in deep blue and gold, a stone causeway of low arches connecting it to the near shore, and a windmill with white sails turning on the outermost tower's broad ledge

THE CRAG-AND-FALLS CASTLE: a castle of dark fitted stone built into the face of a steep crag, a tall waterfall plunging through a wide central arch and continuing its fall to the gorge below, the towers bristling with plain coloured pennants, and a portcullis gate at the base of the crag framed by two squat round towers with conical roofs

THE PALE ISLAND KEEP: a compact castle of ivory-pale stone occupying the whole of a small rocky island, four slender corner turrets rising above crenellated walls, a pictorial crest carved in relief above its arched main gate, a bell hung in a small arch above that gate, and a single lit window glowing amber in the tallest tower

THE CLOUD-BRIDGE CITY: a wide stone bridge climbing in long curved arches from a green hilltop up into a bank of cloud, and at the top a whole small city of white-plastered towers and tiled rooftops sitting on the cloud's flat surface, plain banners of yellow and white hanging between the towers, the bridge's keystones carved with pictorial cloud reliefs

THE STAIR-OF-LIGHT CITADEL: a grand staircase of glowing pale stone rising step by step from a cliff-edge platform up into a city of tall white towers built on a broad cloud bank, each tower topped with a plain dome, coloured pennants strung between them, and a great arched gateway of the same glowing stone marking the stair's top landing

THE SKY WHALE'S BACK VILLAGE: a vast and gentle sky whale drifting slowly above rolling green hills, its broad back level enough to carry a tidy village of thatch-roofed cottages and a small square with a well, a rope-and-plank bridge running from the whale's flank toward a cliff platform, and a weathervane turning on the tallest cottage roof

THE WANDERING TORTOISE TOWN: an ancient tortoise of immense size drifting slowly across a wide plain, its great domed shell worn flat on top and covered in soil and grass enough to hold a hill town of close-packed stone houses, a bell tower at its crown, a rope ladder trailing off the shell's rim, and a small shrine carved into the shell's flank

THE MUSHROOM HOLLOW: a forest of house-sized mushrooms growing in a sheltered hollow, their broad caps glowing softly in coral and cream, a plank walkway running from cap to cap across the stems, a stream winding between the fat bases, and glowing blue flowers filling every gap in the fern-covered floor between them

THE LUMIGROVE POOL: a grove of slender trees whose bark glows a steady warm gold gathered around a perfectly round pool, the reflected glow making the water shine gold, hanging moss draped from every bough also glowing faintly, and a single wooden bench at the pool's edge with a lantern post beside it

THE GLOWFLOWER DELL: a broad natural hollow carpeted entirely in flowers whose petals hold a steady pale blue glow, house-sized toadstools with luminous cream undersides rising at intervals between them, a mossy stone path winding down into the dell from a wooden gate in a hedgerow, and a small arched stone bridge over a shallow glowing stream

THE FLOWERING RUIN ARCH: a grand single arch of ancient pale stone standing alone in a meadow, every surface thick with flowering vines in yellow and pink, the keystone carved with a worn pictorial relief of two fish circling, a gravel path running beneath the arch from one meadow to the next, and a small carved basin at the arch's foot filled with rainwater

THE SUNKEN COURTYARD TEMPLE: a temple of broad stepped platforms half-sunk into a forest floor, its central courtyard now a clear shallow lake fed by a narrow waterfall dropping from the highest remaining wall, flowering vines covering every carved column, and a stone arch with a pictorial sun-face relief still standing intact at the lake's far end

THE OVERGROWN BRIDGE: a wide stone bridge of three tall arches crossing a slow river, the entire surface carpeted in thick green moss and flowering creepers, a large fig tree growing from a crack in the central pier and spreading over the balustrade, and a gap in the canopy above opening onto the sky over the mossy road

THE FLOATING ROOT ISLAND: a broad island drifting slowly above a forested valley, a dense grove of silver-barked trees and a moss-roof cottage on its top, four waterfalls trailing off its curved underside into the canopy below, a tangle of thick pale roots hanging beneath it, and a rope bridge connecting one of those roots to a tall stone platform on the cliff

THE WIZARD'S SPIRAL ON THE SEA STACK: a tall tower coiling upward around a sea stack like a corkscrew of grey-green stone, a glass-domed observatory at its crown, a crooked chimney puffing from a lower floor, a rope bridge swaying from a mid-tower ledge to the clifftop, and a tiny lit window halfway up glowing amber against the dark stone

THE DRIFTING GARDEN ISLE: a wide oval island drifting slowly above a river delta, its surface covered in a terraced garden of flowering hedges and a round stone gazebo at the centre, three long waterfalls trailing off its layered underside, thick braided roots hanging below, and a rope ladder looped around one root whose bottom rung sways over the river
